hits.about: Park Greens 2 is the second phase of a luxury project from developer Damac. Located in Damac Hills 2, the development is a premium collection of 5-bedroom villas. Each residence sits on its own private plot, which also provides space for a swimming pool, Jacuzzi or outdoor movie theater. All homes have floor-to-ceiling panoramic windows and private balconies or terraces.Within walking distance of the development is a green, scenic park totaling 51 million square feet. Park Greens 2 offers residents exclusive amenities including Malibu Beach, multi-sports courts, a pet farm and a paintball park.Damac Hills 2 is a thriving neighborhood filled with life. It is connected to four major highways and other networks that allow easy access to the city. The major community of Damac Hills is just 15 minutes away by car, Al Maktoum International Airport, Dubai International Airport and Mall of the Emirates are within a 30-35 minute radius, while Palm Jumeirah and Dubai Marina are approximately 40 minutes away.Park Greens 2 is one of the most attractive residential developments. This picturesque complex offers its residents the perfect combination of comfort, luxury and modern design. Its convenient location, close to shopping, restaurants, parks and entertainment centers, makes Park Greens 2 an ideal place to live for both families and singles who appreciate comfort, beauty and security.
hits.title: Park Greens 2
